game: TB @ SEA, 2025-10-05 16:05 ET, outdoor, SEA -3.5, total 44.5

script.base: Market prices a close home win, not a blowout: SEA 24.0, TB 20.5. SEA leads by about a score late and can hand Kenneth Walker (48 car / 224 yds, weeks 2-4) the close. Tampa still has to play a full balanced game to get to 20.5, but Bucky Irving (57 car / 200 rush yds and 15 tgt / 185 rec yds in that span) and Mike Evans (20 tgt) are out, so Rachaad White is the lead back and Emeka Egbuka (25 tgt / 215 yds / 321 air, weeks 2-4) is the WR1.
script.flip1: SEA gets up early, Walker and Zach Charbonnet (27 car, weeks 2-4) bleed the clock, and TB abandons the run. White's carries die; Baker Mayfield is forced into Egbuka, Sterling Shepard (13 tgt / 128 yds) and Chris Godwin (10 tgt / 26 yds).
script.flip2: TB hangs in or leads, White inherits a full Irving workload, and SEA has to throw to Jaxon Smith-Njigba (21 tgt / 278 yds / 268 air) into a TB secondary missing Jamel Dean, Christian Izien and Benjamin Morrison. Outdoor weather could also drag the 44.5, but no forecast was saved.

injury_fallout: Pre-game nflverse report, all known before kickoff: TB RB Bucky Irving Out (foot) vacates the backfield lead — weeks 2-4 rushers are Irving 57/200, White 21/94, Mayfield 8/91, Egbuka 1/0; Sean Tucker is not in that L3 rusher line (1-game stand-in 2 rush yds), so White is the next man, not Tucker. TB WR Mike Evans Out (hamstring) removes 20 targets / 89 yds / 227 air; the funnel is Egbuka first, then Shepard, with Godwin (only 26 rec yds on 10 tgt, 146 air) and Cade Otton (8 tgt / 34 yds) as secondary sponges. SEA CB Devon Witherspoon Out (knee) and S Julian Love Out (hamstring) are the coverage losses for that TB pass game; SEA DE DeMarcus Lawrence Out (quad) slightly lowers edge pressure. Other side: TB CB Jamel Dean Out (hip), CB Benjamin Morrison Out (hamstring) and S Christian Izien Out (quad) strip the secondary JSN/Kupp/Horton would attack; SEA T Josh Jones Out (ankle) is a run-blocking hit on Walker, not on these TB legs. No practice-trend or inactive list beyond this report; inactives ~90 min pre-kick are not in the pack.

matchup.shell: No MOFO/MOFC, man/zone or coverage chart in the pack (step 4 limited). What is charted: SEA YPA left 8.0 (50 att), middle 4.93 (28), right 5.1 (73); TB YPA left 5.18 (51), middle 7.25 (20), right 7.83 (54).
matchup.pressure: SEA blitzes only 20%. TB EPA/db is -0.01 vs blitz and 0.26 vs no blitz, so Mayfield is fine in the shell he will mostly see, and Lawrence being out trims what little edge rush SEA had. Low blitz also means fewer forced RB checkdowns, so White's edge is carries, not Irving's 185 receiving yards automatically transferring. TB blitzes 40%; SEA EPA/db is 0.22 vs blitz and 0.17 vs none, so TB's blitz does not scare the SEA offense.
matchup.bleeds: SEA run defense is not a bleed: 3.65 YPC and only 4 runs of 10+ in 4 games; pass explosives 9 of 20+ for 163. The pass bleed is the left side (8.0 YPA) plus the missing CB and safety, while the middle is a strength (4.93). TB run defense is efficient (3.45 YPC) but leaky on explosives (9 runs of 10+); the pass bleed is middle and right, and three DBs are out.
matchup.overlap: TB's new primary, Egbuka (12.8 air yards per target on 25 targets), is a downfield WR1 running into Witherspoon and Love out — that is the overlap, but his side of the field is not charted, and SEA's middle is stingy. SEA's primary, JSN, overlaps the worse secondary (Dean, Morrison, Izien out) and the middle/right YPA bleed, but his 99.5 stand-in sits above a declining last-4 (124, 103, 96, 79) so he is not a selected leg. White's overlap is usage, not a soft run front.

form: Avoiding season averages. White last4 rush yds 14, 65, 12, 17 and rush+rec 16, 66, 14, 46 — a complementary back whose median ties 15.5, with one 65-yard spike, not an RB1 sample. Egbuka last4 rec yds 67, 29, 85, 101 (if listed oldest to newest, the last two clear 76.5); weeks 2-4 he already out-targeted Evans, 215 yards on 321 air, so the Evans absence is an add-on not a creation of the role. Godwin has one listed game (26) on a 26.5 stand-in. JSN's last two (96, 79) are under 99.5. Walker last4 rush 20, 105, 38, 81 is a split around a 59.5 median, with Charbonnet still taking 27 carries. No similar-defense or prior Irving-out game is in the pack.

pre_mortem: It's Monday and this lost because the Irving carries never became White's: Tucker or a two-back rotation held him to another 12-14 yard day, SEA's 3.65 YPC front stuffed the early downs, and once Tampa trailed Mayfield stopped handing the ball off. Egbuka lost because Seattle took away the one healthy vertical receiver, Godwin and Shepard soaked the 20 Evans targets, and the middle-of-field coverage that allows 4.93 YPA was where the ball went, reproducing the 29-yard game. Also possible we were never looking at a real book number — both lines are labeled stand-ins with no price — so there was no market edge to cash.
slip_story: One story only: Tampa's next men up in a competitive 24.0-20.5 game, not a shootout and not a SEA clock-kill. White rush over and Egbuka rec over can win together if TB scores near its implied total with a normal run/pass mix. Do not add a game under, a Walker over (needs SEA to lead and run, and Jones is out), or Tucker (he is the way the White leg loses). JSN over 99.5 was the other injury overlap and was left off: form 96 and 79 under the median stand-in, so a lean the recent data disagrees with.
